premise: At dusk hide-and-seek, Owl finds Raccoon because he flies without a sound, and Firefly is found at once because her tail keeps blinking; so she seeks instead, and when Owl hides, silent, where nobody can hear him, her light finds him.
inspiration: The folk "who can hide best" contest, turned: the one who can't hide lights up the game, and looking beats listening.
lesson: What seems like a weakness can be just what the game needs.
learning: Owls fly without a sound on their soft feathers.

en-US.title: Owl Flies Without a Sound
en-US.text: {canvas:sunset 0.7} [softly] The sun was going down. Up on a branch, {owl:enter} {owl:go to branches} Owl {owl:live doze hold} was still asleep. Along came {raccoon:enter} Raccoon. {raccoon:hop} [excited] "Owl! Let's play hide-and-seek!" {owl:live doze resume} Owl opened one eye, then the other. {sfx:hoot} "Hoo. I'll seek." {raccoon:face happy} Raccoon hid his usual way: {raccoon:live peekaboo hold} paws over his eyes. "If I can't see Owl, Owl can't see me!" {canvas:night 0.8} The sky grew dark. {firefly:enter} {firefly:go to meadow} Firefly tucked herself down in the grass. {firefly:live tuck-in} Owl {owl:go to raccoon} flew down. Not a flap. Not a swish. His soft feathers made no sound at all. [whispers] "Found you!" {raccoon:live peekaboo resume} [laughs] "I didn't hear you coming!" And Firefly? {firefly:glow 1 0.5s x2 #FFE27A} {sfx:twinkle} Blink… blink… went her little tail. {firefly:face sad} [sad] "I'm no good at hiding," she sighed. {raccoon:face happy} {raccoon:hop x2} "Then YOU seek!" said Raccoon. So Owl {owl:go to branches another} flew off to hide, without a sound. Raccoon listened. Nothing. {firefly:face happy} But Firefly {firefly:go to owl} flew from tree to tree, {firefly:glow 1 2.5s hold #FFE27A} glowing her brightest… and there was Owl, in her light. {firefly:live wave} "Found you!" {owl:face surprised} {owl:live hoot} "Hoo! How?" [happily] "I didn't listen," said Firefly. "I looked!"

es-ES.title: Búho vuela sin hacer ruido
es-ES.text: {canvas:sunset 0.7} [softly] Se estaba poniendo el sol. En una rama, {owl:enter} {owl:go to branches} Búho {owl:live doze hold} seguía dormido. Llegó {raccoon:enter} Mapache. {raccoon:hop} [excited] —¡Búho! ¿Jugamos al escondite? {owl:live doze resume} Búho abrió un ojo, y luego el otro. {sfx:hoot} —Uuh. La ligo yo. {raccoon:face happy} Mapache se escondió a su manera: {raccoon:live peekaboo hold} tapándose los ojos. —¡Si yo no veo a Búho, Búho no me ve a mí! {canvas:night 0.8} Se hizo de noche. {firefly:enter} {firefly:go to meadow} Luciérnaga se agachó entre la hierba. {firefly:live tuck-in} Búho {owl:go to raccoon} bajó volando. Ni un aleteo. Ni un frufrú. Sus plumas suaves no hacían ningún ruido. [whispers] —¡Te pillé! {raccoon:live peekaboo resume} [laughs] —¡No te he oído llegar! ¿Y Luciérnaga? {firefly:glow 1 0.5s x2 #FFE27A} {sfx:twinkle} Su colita se encendía y se apagaba. {firefly:face sad} [sad] —Qué mal me escondo —suspiró. {raccoon:face happy} {raccoon:hop x2} —¡Pues la ligas tú! —dijo Mapache. Así que Búho {owl:go to branches another} se fue a esconder, sin un ruido. Mapache escuchó. Nada de nada. {firefly:face happy} Pero Luciérnaga {firefly:go to owl} voló de árbol en árbol, {firefly:glow 1 2.5s hold #FFE27A} brillando con todas sus fuerzas… y allí estaba Búho, a la luz. {firefly:live wave} —¡Te pillé! {owl:face surprised} {owl:live hoot} —¡Uuh! ¿Cómo? [happily] —No he escuchado —dijo Luciérnaga—. ¡He mirado!

ja-JP.title: フクロウくんは しずかに とぶ
ja-JP.text: {canvas:sunset 0.7}[softly]お日さまが、しずんでいきます。えだの上では、{owl:enter}{owl:go to branches}フクロウくんが{owl:live doze hold}まだすやすや。そこへ{raccoon:enter}アライグマくん。{raccoon:hop}[excited]「フクロウくん！かくれんぼしよう！」 {owl:live doze resume}フクロウくんは、目をひとつ、ふたつ、ぱちり。{sfx:hoot}「ホウ。ぼくがさがそう」 {raccoon:face happy}アライグマくんは、いつものかくれかた。{raccoon:live peekaboo hold}目をかくして、「見えない、見えない。だから、見つからない！」 {canvas:night 0.8}空がくらくなりました。{firefly:enter}{firefly:go to meadow}ホタルさんは、くさのなかへ。{firefly:live tuck-in}フクロウくんが、{owl:go to raccoon}すうっとおりてきます。ばさっとも、ひゅっともいいません。やわらかいはねは、音ひとつたてないのです。[whispers]「みーつけた！」 {raccoon:live peekaboo resume}[laughs]「ぜんぜん、きこえなかった！」 ホタルさんは？{firefly:glow 1 0.5s x2 #FFE27A}{sfx:twinkle}おしりが、ぴか…ぴか…{firefly:face sad}[sad]「わたし、かくれるの、へたなの」 {raccoon:face happy}{raccoon:hop x2}「じゃあ、こんどはきみがさがして！」 そこでフクロウくんは、{owl:go to branches another}音もなく、かくれにいきました。アライグマくんが耳をすませても、しーん。{firefly:face happy}でもホタルさんは、{firefly:go to owl}木から木へとんで、{firefly:glow 1 2.5s hold #FFE27A}ぴかーっと、いちばん明るく光ると…光のなかに、フクロウくん！{firefly:live wave}「みーつけた！」 {owl:face surprised}{owl:live hoot}「ホウ！どうして？」 [happily]「きいたんじゃないの。見たの！」 とホタルさん。

de-DE.title: Die Eule fliegt ganz leise
de-DE.text: {canvas:sunset 0.7} [softly] Die Sonne ging unter. Oben auf einem Ast schlief {owl:enter} {owl:go to branches} die Eule {owl:live doze hold} noch tief und fest. Da kam {raccoon:enter} der Waschbär. {raccoon:hop} [excited] „Eule! Spielen wir Verstecken?“ {owl:live doze resume} Die Eule öffnete ein Auge, dann das andere. {sfx:hoot} „Schuhu. Ich suche.“ {raccoon:face happy} Der Waschbär versteckte sich wie immer: {raccoon:live peekaboo hold} Pfoten vor die Augen. „Wenn ich die Eule nicht sehe, sieht die Eule mich auch nicht!“ {canvas:night 0.8} Es wurde dunkel. {firefly:enter} {firefly:go to meadow} Das Glühwürmchen duckte sich tief ins Gras. {firefly:live tuck-in} Die Eule {owl:go to raccoon} flog herab. Kein Flattern. Kein Rauschen. Ihre weichen Federn machten überhaupt kein Geräusch. [whispers] „Hab dich!“ {raccoon:live peekaboo resume} [laughs] „Ich hab dich gar nicht kommen hören!“ Und das Glühwürmchen? {firefly:glow 1 0.5s x2 #FFE27A} {sfx:twinkle} Blink… blink… machte sein kleines Lämpchen. {firefly:face sad} [sad] „Ich kann mich gar nicht gut verstecken“, seufzte das Glühwürmchen. {raccoon:face happy} {raccoon:hop x2} „Dann suchst DU!“, rief der Waschbär. Also flog die Eule {owl:go to branches another} davon und versteckte sich, ganz ohne einen Laut. Der Waschbär lauschte. Nichts. {firefly:face happy} Aber das Glühwürmchen {firefly:go to owl} flog von Baum zu Baum {firefly:glow 1 2.5s hold #FFE27A} und leuchtete, so hell es nur konnte… und da saß die Eule, mitten in seinem Licht. {firefly:live wave} „Hab dich!“ {owl:face surprised} {owl:live hoot} „Schuhu! Wie denn das?“ [happily] „Ich habe nicht gelauscht“, sagte das Glühwürmchen. „Ich habe geguckt!“

fr-FR.title: Hibou vole sans un bruit
fr-FR.text: {canvas:sunset 0.7} [softly] Le soleil se couchait. Sur une branche, {owl:enter} {owl:go to branches} Hibou {owl:live doze hold} dormait encore. Et voilà qu’arrive {raccoon:enter} Raton laveur. {raccoon:hop} [excited] « Hibou ! On joue à cache-cache ? » {owl:live doze resume} Hibou a ouvert un œil, puis l’autre. {sfx:hoot} « Hou. C’est moi qui cherche. » {raccoon:face happy} Raton laveur s’est caché à sa façon : {raccoon:live peekaboo hold} les pattes sur les yeux. « Si je ne vois pas Hibou, Hibou ne me voit pas ! » {canvas:night 0.8} Le ciel s’est assombri. {firefly:enter} {firefly:go to meadow} Luciole s’est blottie dans l’herbe. {firefly:live tuck-in} Hibou {owl:go to raccoon} est descendu en volant. Pas un battement. Pas un froufrou. Ses plumes toutes douces ne faisaient aucun bruit. [whispers] « Trouvé ! » {raccoon:live peekaboo resume} [laughs] « Je ne t’ai pas entendu arriver ! » Et Luciole ? {firefly:glow 1 0.5s x2 #FFE27A} {sfx:twinkle} Sa petite lanterne clignotait… clignotait… {firefly:face sad} [sad] « Je ne sais pas me cacher », a-t-elle soupiré. {raccoon:face happy} {raccoon:hop x2} « Alors c’est TOI qui cherches ! » a dit Raton laveur. Et Hibou {owl:go to branches another} s’est envolé pour se cacher, sans un bruit. Raton laveur a écouté. Rien. {firefly:face happy} Mais Luciole {firefly:go to owl} a volé d’arbre en arbre, {firefly:glow 1 2.5s hold #FFE27A} en brillant de toutes ses forces… et Hibou était là, dans sa lumière. {firefly:live wave} « Trouvé ! » {owl:face surprised} {owl:live hoot} « Hou ! Comment tu as fait ? » [happily] « Je n’ai pas écouté, a dit Luciole. J’ai regardé ! »

it-IT.title: Gufo vola senza un rumore
it-IT.text: {canvas:sunset 0.7} [softly] Il sole stava tramontando. Su un ramo, {owl:enter} {owl:go to branches} Gufo {owl:live doze hold} dormiva ancora. Ecco arrivare {raccoon:enter} Procione. {raccoon:hop} [excited] «Gufo! Giochiamo a nascondino!» {owl:live doze resume} Gufo ha aperto un occhio, poi l'altro. {sfx:hoot} «Uuh. Conto io.» {raccoon:face happy} Procione si è nascosto alla sua maniera: {raccoon:live peekaboo hold} con le zampe sugli occhi. «Se io non vedo Gufo, Gufo non vede me!» {canvas:night 0.8} Il cielo si è fatto scuro. {firefly:enter} {firefly:go to meadow} Lucciola si è accucciata giù nell'erba. {firefly:live tuck-in} Gufo {owl:go to raccoon} è sceso in volo. Neanche un battito d'ali. Neanche un fruscio. Le sue piume morbide non facevano nessun rumore. [whispers] «Tana per Procione!» {raccoon:live peekaboo resume} [laughs] «Non ti ho sentito arrivare!» E Lucciola? {firefly:glow 1 0.5s x2 #FFE27A} {sfx:twinkle} Accesa… spenta… faceva la sua codina. {firefly:face sad} [sad] «Io non so nascondermi», ha sospirato. {raccoon:face happy} {raccoon:hop x2} «Allora conti TU!» ha detto Procione. Così Gufo {owl:go to branches another} è volato via a nascondersi, senza un rumore. Procione ha ascoltato. Niente. {firefly:face happy} Ma Lucciola {firefly:go to owl} è volata da un albero all'altro, {firefly:glow 1 2.5s hold #FFE27A} brillando più forte che poteva… ed ecco Gufo, nella sua luce. {firefly:live wave} «Tana per Gufo!» {owl:face surprised} {owl:live hoot} «Uuh! Come hai fatto?» [happily] «Non ho ascoltato», ha detto Lucciola. «Ho guardato!»

zh-TW.title: 貓頭鷹靜悄悄地飛
zh-TW.text: {canvas:sunset 0.7}[softly]太陽慢慢下山了。高高的樹枝上，{owl:enter}{owl:go to branches}貓頭鷹{owl:live doze hold}還在睡覺。{raccoon:enter}浣熊走了過來。{raccoon:hop}[excited]「貓頭鷹！我們來玩躲貓貓！」 {owl:live doze resume}貓頭鷹睜開一隻眼睛，又睜開另一隻。{sfx:hoot}「咕——我來找。」 {raccoon:face happy}浣熊用老方法躲起來：{raccoon:live peekaboo hold}用手掌蒙住眼睛。「只要我看不到貓頭鷹，貓頭鷹就看不到我！」 {canvas:night 0.8}天黑了。{firefly:enter}{firefly:go to meadow}螢火蟲躲進草叢裡。{firefly:live tuck-in}貓頭鷹{owl:go to raccoon}飛了下來。沒有啪啪聲，也沒有咻咻聲。牠的羽毛軟綿綿的，一點聲音也沒有。[whispers]「找到你了！」 {raccoon:live peekaboo resume}[laughs]「我都沒聽到你來！」 那螢火蟲呢？{firefly:glow 1 0.5s x2 #FFE27A}{sfx:twinkle}牠的小尾巴一閃……一閃……{firefly:face sad}[sad]「我好不會躲喔。」 牠嘆了一口氣。{raccoon:face happy}{raccoon:hop x2}「那換你來找！」 浣熊說。於是，貓頭鷹{owl:go to branches another}靜悄悄地飛去躲起來。浣熊仔細聽。什麼也聽不到。{firefly:face happy}可是螢火蟲{firefly:go to owl}從這棵樹飛到那棵樹，{firefly:glow 1 2.5s hold #FFE27A}亮得好亮好亮……貓頭鷹就在牠的光裡！{firefly:live wave}「找到你了！」 {owl:face surprised}{owl:live hoot}「咕！你怎麼找到的？」 [happily]「我不是用聽的，」 螢火蟲說，「我是用看的！」

zh-HK.title: 靜靜飛的貓頭鷹
zh-HK.text: {canvas:sunset 0.7}[softly]太陽慢慢下山了。樹枝上，{owl:enter}{owl:go to branches}貓頭鷹{owl:live doze hold}還在呼呼大睡。{raccoon:enter}浣熊走了過來。{raccoon:hop}[excited]「貓頭鷹！我哋玩捉迷藏呀！」 {owl:live doze resume}貓頭鷹張開一隻眼，再張開另一隻。{sfx:hoot}「咕——我嚟捉。」 {raccoon:face happy}浣熊照舊用老方法躲起來：{raccoon:live peekaboo hold}用手掩住眼睛。「我睇唔到貓頭鷹，貓頭鷹就睇唔到我！」 {canvas:night 0.8}天黑了。{firefly:enter}{firefly:go to meadow}螢火蟲躲進草叢裏。{firefly:live tuck-in}貓頭鷹{owl:go to raccoon}飛了下來。沒有拍翼聲，也沒有呼呼聲。牠的羽毛軟綿綿的，一點聲音也沒有。[whispers]「捉到你喇！」 {raccoon:live peekaboo resume}[laughs]「我完全聽唔到你嚟㗎！」 螢火蟲呢？{firefly:glow 1 0.5s x2 #FFE27A}{sfx:twinkle}牠的小尾巴一閃……一閃……{firefly:face sad}[sad]「我真係唔識匿。」 牠歎氣說。{raccoon:face happy}{raccoon:hop x2}「噉到你捉！」 浣熊說。於是，貓頭鷹{owl:go to branches another}靜靜地飛去躲起來，一點聲音也沒有。浣熊豎起耳朵聽。甚麼也聽不到。{firefly:face happy}可是螢火蟲{firefly:go to owl}從這棵樹飛到那棵樹，{firefly:glow 1 2.5s hold #FFE27A}亮起最亮最亮的光……貓頭鷹就在牠的光裏！{firefly:live wave}「捉到你喇！」 {owl:face surprised}{owl:live hoot}「咕！你點搵到我㗎？」 [happily]「我唔係靠聽，」 螢火蟲說，「我係靠睇！」

hoot.prompt: a single soft owl hoot at dusk, gentle, realistic field recording

twinkle.prompt: two tiny soft twinkles, like a little light blinking on and off, playful
